residual_root_causes.thinking_tag_closed: 12/12 across all models. The structural tag triggers on '</thinking>', but the models emit their native '<think>' reasoning tag (not '<thinking>'), so the trigger never fires and the JSON is never constrained (failure_code extra_prose_outside_envelope). Fixture/family-premise mismatch, not a grammar-engine limit; the model-free per-family verify passed because it was fed the ideal '<thinking>...</thinking>{json}' string. Needs a fixture/family redesign (trigger on the model's actual reasoning tag) - deferred.
residual_root_causes.gemma_function_call_and_nested: gemma-4-31b-it-4bit degenerates at the token level inside grammar-free fields: repeated characters inside a JSON string value (e.g. '/////lllll') and long whitespace runs, hitting max_tokens=128 (finish_reason=length) before the structure closes. The whitespace cap (16) fixed enum_constrained on gemma but nested/function still exceed the token budget. Follow-up mitigations: tighter max_whitespace_cnt, higher max_tokens for gemma, or a string-length bound. Gemma-specific; the Qwen models do not show this.
